rules.problem: Kidney disease and kidney stone branches use active_condition rather than the page criteria. Kidney disease and kidney stone urgency is likely never triggered by findings alone.

summary: Most consequential: the Urgent priority rule encodes kidney disease and kidney stone danger signs as active_condition, not the page criteria, so those two red-box bullets are effectively not triggered by findings. The uncomplicated pyelonephritis rule has no exclusion of the complicating features and the same diagnosis as the complicated one. Everything else traces to the page; remaining issues are loose concept matches (body pain, urinary tract problem) and 'exclude X' encoded as possible.
